name: paseo-aranjuez-webar-8thwall
description: Sistema WebAR basado en Image Tracking (8th Wall) para la promocion interactiva de los locales comerciales de Paseo Aranjuez - Proyecto de Grado UCB Cochabamba
author: Nicolette Chalup

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c green,cyan "wrangler dev --port 8787" "vite"
scripts.deploy: wrangler whoami && npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply armodels-db --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.test: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .test-worker && node tests/istqb-validation.test.js && node --test tests/worker.test.mjs
